samples.title: Wedding season is EATING me alive (in a good way)
samples.body:
Quick update from the trenches! Seven weddings in five weekends for Rosebud Lane, my knees are done, my camera has more miles on it than my car. Best one was a barn wedding in Hood River where the flower girl tried to steal my lens cap and almost got away with it. I had to chase a four year old in a tulle dress through a field of goats while holding a camera that costs more than my first car. She won. I got the cap back eventually but only because her mom bribed her with a cupcake.

Also, I cried at a wedding for the first time in like a year. The groom's grandpa gave a toast about meeting his wife at a roller rink in 1961 and I had to put the camera down for a sec. Don't tell anybody, I'm a professional.

Sam says hi and says I'm not allowed to book anything on his birthday weekend again. Fair. Love you all, see you at Labor Day.

samples.title: We got a dog?? We got a dog.
samples.body:
So this happened. Sam and I went to the shelter on Saturday "just to look" (I know, I know) and we came home with Pickle. He's a two year old something, the shelter said beagle mix but he's got legs like a deer so who knows. He is scared of the vacuum, the mailman, and one specific lamp. He is not scared of eating an entire loaf of bread off the counter, which he did on day two.

Mom, yes, he can come to Easter. He's very polite with people, it's just lamps.

I've already taken like 900 pictures of him. I'll spare you most of them. Ok I'll spare you some of them. Pics below!!

samples.title: Christmas recap + the photo
samples.body:
Thanks everyone for a really great Christmas. I know the group photo took forever and I know Uncle Greg was "freezing" but look how good it came out! I put the full size version in the shared folder so you can print it, and yes Grandma, I made one where you can see your new sweater.

Honestly my favorite part was the game of Spoons that got way too intense. Lars, I'm still not over it. You know what you did.

This year was a big one for me work wise. I second shot or led 31 weddings for Marisol, which is a lot, and I learned a ton. I'm not totally sure what next year looks like yet but I'm excited about it. Love you guys. Drive safe everybody who's still on the road.
